content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user of the task reporting page","i_want":"to download the filtered and sorted task report as an Excel file","so_that":"I can review and share my task data outside the application","business_description":"The reporting page lets the user download task data to an Excel file. The file reflects the filters and sorting applied in the task view, has clear column headers, uses one consistent date format, and includes the generation timestamp in its filename. If there is no data to export, the user sees a message instead of an empty file.","business_value":"Users can take their filtered task data into other tools for review and sharing without re-entering it manually.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"the reporting page shows a list of tasks","when":"the user clicks the Export to Excel control","then":"the browser downloads one .xlsx file"},{"given":"the report has filters on Status, Priority and Date Range, a title search, and a sort on one of Creation Date, Due Date, Status or Priority applied","when":"the user exports the report","then":"the rows in the Excel file are exactly the rows shown in the report, in the same order as the report"},{"given":"an export has been generated","when":"the user opens the Excel file","then":"the first row contains a column header for every exported field and every date cell uses the same date format"},{"given":"an export is generated at a given time","when":"the file is downloaded","then":"the filename contains the date and time of generation"},{"given":"the current filters and search match zero tasks","when":"the user clicks Export to Excel","then":"no file is downloaded and the message stating that there is no data to export is shown to the user"},{"given":"the Excel generation decision is still open","when":"the export work starts","then":"the decision on frontend or backend generation is documented with rationale and trade-offs before the export is built"}],"edge_cases":["Filters and search match zero tasks: no file is produced and a message is shown; the exact wording of the message is not specified in the PRD and must be confirmed with the product owner.","The report has no tasks at all before any filter is applied: same empty-data behaviour applies.","A sort field is not one of Creation Date, Due Date, Status or Priority: not defined in the PRD; the export must use the same sort as the report view.","Date Range filter boundaries (inclusive or exclusive) are not specified in the PRD; the export must match the report view.","Very large result sets: maximum export size and performance limits are not specified in the PRD.","Time zone used for the timestamp in the filename and for dates in the file is not specified in the PRD."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-report","US-filter-search-sort-report"],"definition_of_done":["Decision on frontend or backend Excel generation is documented with rationale and trade-offs","Export control is available on the reporting page and downloads an .xlsx file","Exported rows match the filters, search and sort applied in the report view, verified by automated tests","Excel file has a header row with clear column names","All date cells in the file use one documented date format","Filename contains the generation timestamp","Empty-data case shows a user message and produces no file","Wording of the empty-data message is confirmed with the product owner","Automated test suite for the export passes"]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"excel-generation-decision","title":"[BE] Decide where the Excel file is generated, frontend or backend","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Resolve the open decision whether the Excel file is generated in the browser or on the server. Compare both options on data volume, file size limits, consistency of filters and sorting with the report API, and maintenance. Record the decision and rationale in the project documentation.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-3a63e0ce"],"derived_reason":"decision_spike","is_spike":true,"definition_of_done":["Documented decision on frontend or backend generation with rationale","Trade-offs of both options written down","Open questions for the product owner listed"]},{"key_slug":"report-export-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add report export endpoint that returns a filtered, sorted Excel file","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"If the spike selects backend generation, add an endpoint that accepts the same filters, search and sort parameters as the task report API and returns an .xlsx file. The file has a header row, one consistent date format, and a filename containing the generation timestamp. If the spike selects frontend generation, this task instead provides the report data in the form the browser needs to build the file.
